title: Assessment of MDD Management in Andalusia
brief_summary: The main objectives of this study are to describe medical professionals responsible of the management of patients with MDD in a representative region of Andalusia (in terms of type of sites managing the disease, and referral to SC criteria); Describe MDD patient characteristics at inclusion in the PISMA-Ep Study; and to evaluate those factors associated to a higher incidence of referral from PC to SC.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* MDD Diagnosis Participants of the PismaEP study 18 yo. or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* No specific exclusion criteria
study_population: MDD patients treated in Primary Care or Secondary Care in the Region of Granada and recruited for the PISMA-Ep Study
